invariants.rationale: The metaClient is used to reload table config, so it is expected to be non-null when accessed.
inFlightInstantTimestamp is passed to writer methods and should be non-null for such usage.
The table config may be reloaded and is expected to be accessible.
If there is an in-flight instant, its value should be non-null.
A HoodieTableMetaClient instance should have a non-null base path.
